## SECURITY REQUIREMENTS (CLIENT SIDE)

* Use ONLY backend-provided permissions
* Do NOT define or hardcode privileges
* Hide/disable UI based on permissions
* Always assume backend is final authority
* Use SAME API as web
* Subdomain + auth routing alignment (MANDATORY):
  - Login UX must align with the architecture’s `auth` host model (even if implemented via deep links / in-app browser / system browser)
  - After login, navigation must land on the correct tenant/app context (handle vs `app` fallback), driven by backend responses (not hardcoded tenant handles)
  - Local dev must support `*.lvh.me` where applicable for parity with web testing
* Token/session storage (MANDATORY):
  - Define how auth tokens/sessions are stored (secure storage) and rotated/logged out
  - Do not store secrets in logs
